articles.title: I was getting tired of manually copy-pasting MTProto proxies
articles.normalized_title: i was getting tired of manually copy-pasting mtproto proxies
articles.excerpt: I was getting tired of manually copy-pasting MTProto proxies from Telegram channels only to find half of them dead on arrival. So I set up this scraper to do the boring work. It runs on a cron job, scrapes public Telegram channels for proxy links, tests each one with fake-TLS support, and publishes only the working ones. The output updates hourly in a plain text file and a web listing. You can grab the latest list from here: https://github.com/Yagami200/free-mtproto-proxies Just pipe it into your Telegram client config or script. Saved me from clicking through 50 channels every week.
